title: Ostomy Supply Program Payer Claims and Remittance Posting
content:
Every refill shipped on a payer tier of the Ostomy Supply Program is billed to the payer named by the program's coverage record by one original claim per shipment, with the ship date as the date of service; the self-pay tier files no claims.

## Filing limit

An original claim must be transmitted no later than the tier's timely filing limit in calendar days after the date of service of the shipment it bills, counted in calendar days from that ship date with the last day allowed. A shipment whose filing limit has passed is billed to neither the payer nor the customer and is written off by Larkfield.

*Boundary (hypothetical, 90-day limit, ship date day 0):* transmission on day 90 is timely; on day 91 the limit has passed and the shipment is written off.

## Corrected and void claims

A corrected claim replaces an original claim when the units, item or dates billed were wrong or some of the units were returned, and a void claim withdraws an original claim when all of its units were returned; both reference the same shipment as the original.

## Posting a remittance

When a remittance posts, the patient responsibility added to the customer's balance is the allowed amount less the amount the payer paid, which the remittance itemizes as deductible, coinsurance and copay. Larkfield never posts more than that, and never bills the customer the difference between its billed charge and the allowed amount on a payer tier.

*Hypothetical illustration:* billed charge USD 120.00, allowed amount USD 80.00, payer paid USD 64.00. The patient responsibility posted is USD 16.00 (USD 80.00 less USD 64.00); the USD 40.00 between the billed charge and the allowed amount is never billed to the customer.

## Secondary coverage

- On tiers where crossover to secondary applies and the customer has an in-effect secondary coverage record, the patient responsibility is crossed over to the secondary payer, and the secondary payer's payment is posted as a balance adjustment for a secondary payer payment against that remittance before any amount is statemented.
- On other tiers a secondary coverage is billed by Larkfield's billing team only after the primary remittance posts.

## Medicaid

On the Medicaid tier a customer is never billed for a Medicaid-covered item beyond the patient responsibility the Medicaid remittance shows.
